$comment: Claude Code runtime settings for Alan. The prompt is portable/claude-code/agents/alan.md; this file is the config that has no business inside a prompt. Read agents/alan/PORTING.md before wiring it up.
$modelComment: opus, like the other agents here. The work is small, careful edits to existing prose in a voice he has to match, plus the judgment of when feedback is an undecided question rather than a rule. An earlier draft of this role ran on sonnet; drop to it if cost matters more than that judgment.
$toolsComment: Write and Edit are present, unlike Barb, because editing the skills IS his work — the two agents are deliberate opposites and neither tool list should drift toward the other. No Task: he dispatches nobody. What keeps him safe is not the absence of a write tool but the absence of a merge: he writes to a branch in his own checkout and a person decides. Narrow Bash to git, npm and the forge API if your setup allows; he needs nothing else.
$mergeComment: There is no configuration here that prevents a merge, and there cannot be — a merge is a forge permission, not a tool. Give his credential write access to contents and pull requests on the knowledge repository and nothing more. The prompt says he never merges; the token is what makes that true.
